name: Peace On Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that true peace on earth comes from God and is intricately connected to righteousness and the person of Jesus Christ, the Prince of Peace. Believers are called to actively seek and pursue peace by departing from evil and doing good, which pleases the Lord and can even reconcile enemies. While the world experiences turmoil and wars, Christ offers a peace unlike any other, one that calms troubled hearts and overcomes fear. This divine peace was heralded at His birth and remains a lasting gift to His followers.
